views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "Departments"."department_name",
  "Departments"."department_id"
FROM Departments
WHERE
  "Departments"."department_id" IN (
    SELECT
      department_id
    FROM Degree_Programs
    GROUP BY
      department_id
    ORDER BY
      COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
views.description:
Task: Identify the department with the highest number of degree offerings, returning the department's name and unique identifier.
Required outputs: Department Name; Department ID

validated_on: What is the name and id of the department with the most number of degrees ?
